## Checklist

- [ ] `mise run ci` passes locally
- [ ] Tests cover new or changed behaviour (integration tests use the fake control plane)
- [ ] A change to the policy, the session frames or what the agent sends updates `docs/`
- [ ] Nothing new is sent to the platform beyond timings, status codes, classes and counts
- [ ] Controls: says whether this implements, weakens or removes a control (supply chain, agent identity, policy)
- [ ] Breaking change? The title has `!` and the body explains the migration
